n6f1b3141f6c.s: VB-G RAM G, which replaced MGNREGA, guarantees how many days of rural wage employment in a year?
n6f1b3141f6c.x: VB-G RAM G raised the rural employment guarantee from 100 days under MGNREGA to 125 days.

n48683f1ef98.s: The three pillars of the World Economic Forum's Inclusive Development Index are:
o: GDP growth; inflation control; fiscal consolidation
Growth and development; inclusion; intergenerational equity and sustainability
n48683f1ef98.x: The IDI rests on growth and development, inclusion, and intergenerational equity and sustainability.

nindian-economy-70-9.s: Infrastructure development is a requirement for inclusive growth mainly because it:
o: Reduces the need for social spending
Replaces the need for agricultural revival
nindian-economy-70-9.x: Infrastructure widens access and economic opportunities for all, which is why it is needed for inclusive growth.

n63e382d6c67.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about inclusive growth?
o: It looks at both the pace and the pattern of growth
Rural development, agriculture and farm credit are important instruments of it
A high national-income growth rate by itself is sufficient to ensure it
Its benefits are meant to be shared by all sections of society
n63e382d6c67.x: Inclusive growth is not expected from high national-income growth alone; it also needs instruments such as rural development, agriculture and farm credit.

n5935f2cc4c8.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Higher GNI per capita – always a higher HDI
GNI per capita – a means of development
n5935f2cc4c8.x: Income (GNI) is a means rather than the end of development; HDI adds health and education, so higher GNI per capita does not guarantee a higher HDI.

nindian-economy-69-8.s: The human development approach is broader than a primarily economic measure because it focuses on:
nindian-economy-69-8.x: The human development approach looks at people, their opportunities and their choices, not just income and output.

n4c90f289dd2.s: NITI Aayog's January 2024 discussion paper on multidimensional poverty covered which period?
n4c90f289dd2.x: The paper covered the nine years from 2013-14 to 2022-23; 2015-16 to 2019-21 is the period of the Progress Review 2023.

n2ebaca8e348.s: Which of the following was introduced in the Human Development Report of 1997?
n2ebaca8e348.x: The HPI dates to HDR 1997; GDI/GEM came in 1995 and MPI, GII and IHDI in 2010.

n27a1db3411e.s: The standard of living dimension of India's National MPI has how many indicators?
n27a1db3411e.x: Health has three indicators, education two and standard of living seven.

n60400ea6e62.s: In the Global MPI, nutrition and child mortality are indicators of which dimension?
n60400ea6e62.x: Nutrition and child mortality fall under health; years of schooling and school attendance fall under education.

n7ad01d13ed3.s: As per the Global MPI 2022, how many people in India moved out of multidimensional poverty between 2005-06 and 2019-21?
n7ad01d13ed3.x: The Global MPI 2022 reported that 414 million people in India moved out of multidimensional poverty between 2005-06 and 2019-21.

n8a83f66e72e.s: The World Bank's 2022 poverty estimate (23.9% at $4.20 a day) differs from the MPI estimate for 2022-23 (11.28%) because the two:
o: Use different poverty lines and count poverty differently
Use the same line but different years
Are both based only on income
n8a83f66e72e.x: The estimates differ because they use different poverty lines and methods of counting poverty.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the three pillars of India's inclusive growth model?
new.x: The three pillars are Market Economics, Empowerment and Pragmatism; Antyodaya is a common distractor.

new.s: Which Article directs that ownership and control of material resources be distributed to subserve the common good?
new.x: Article 39(b) deals with distributing material resources to subserve the common good.

new.s: Which Article requires that the economic system must not result in concentration of wealth to the common detriment?
new.x: Article 39(c) guards against concentration of wealth and means of production to the common detriment.

new.s: Clause (2) of Article 38, on minimising inequalities in income and status, was added by the:
new.x: Article 38(2) came with the 44th Amendment (1978); the 25th Amendment (1971) inserted Article 31C.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Bhagwati-Sen debate:
1. Bhagwati favours rapid market-led growth first.
2. Sen co-wrote 'An Uncertain Glory' with Jean Dreze.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Bhagwati puts market-led growth first; Sen, with Jean Dreze, wrote An Uncertain Glory (2013).

new.s: The Fifth Plan's 'Garibi Hatao' is an example of which approach to poverty?
new.x: Garibi Hatao of the 5th Plan is a direct attack on poverty, unlike the trickle-down growth-first approach.

new.s: The SHG movement illustrates which approach to poverty reduction?
new.x: The SHG movement is the bottom-up approach to poverty.

new.s: The welfare approach to poverty is best illustrated by:
new.x: The Nordic states illustrate the welfare approach; SHGs are bottom-up and Garibi Hatao is direct attack.

new.s: The Eleventh Five Year Plan, the first to make inclusive growth its objective, covered:
new.x: The 11th Plan ran from 2007 to 2012; 2012-17 was the 12th Plan.

new.s: The Aspirational Blocks Programme, launched in January 2023, covers how many blocks?
new.x: The Aspirational Blocks Programme (Jan 2023) covers 500 blocks.

new.s: MSMEs account for about what share of India's GDP?
new.x: MSMEs make up about 31.1% of GDP; 35.4% is their share of manufacturing output and 48.58% of exports.

new.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's Super Six, Talliki Vandanam gives how much per school child?
new.x: Talliki Vandanam gives ₹15,000 per school child; ₹20,000 per farmer is Annadata Sukhibhava.

new.s: Which Super Six scheme of Andhra Pradesh gives ₹20,000 per farmer?
new.x: Annadata Sukhibhava gives ₹20,000 per farmer.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (AP scheme – benefit) is correctly matched?
o: Talliki Vandanam – free bus travel for women
new.x: Deepam-2 gives 3 free LPG cylinders; Stree Shakti is free bus travel for women and Talliki Vandanam gives ₹15,000 per school child.

new.s: Amma Vodi and YSR Rythu Bharosa were part of which Andhra Pradesh welfare package (2019-24)?
new.x: Navaratnalu (2019-24) included Amma Vodi and YSR Rythu Bharosa; the Super Six schemes are its successors.

new.s: In the WEF Inclusive Development Index 2018, India ranked ____ among 74 emerging economies.
new.x: India was 62nd of 74 emerging economies in the IDI 2018.

new.s: As per the World Bank, India's poverty at the $4.20-a-day line fell from 57.7% to:
new.x: At $4.20 a day poverty fell from 57.7% to 23.9%; 27.1% to 5.3% is the $3-a-day line.

new.s: In HDR 2025, which neighbouring country was tied with India at rank 130?
new.x: Bangladesh tied with India at 130; Sri Lanka and Maldives ranked above India.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about HDR 2025:
1. Sri Lanka ranked above India.
2. India ranked above all other original BRICS countries.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Sri Lanka and Maldives ranked above India; India was the lowest among the five original BRICS.

new.s: Which country topped the HDI in HDR 2025?
new.x: Iceland (0.972) topped HDR 2025; Switzerland topped HDR 2023-24.

new.s: Which country topped HDR 2023-24 with an HDI value of 0.967?
new.x: Switzerland topped HDR 2023-24 (0.967); Iceland topped HDR 2025.

new.s: HDR 2021/22, 'Uncertain Times, Unsettled Lives', introduced the idea of:
new.x: HDR 2021/22 described a new 'uncertainty complex'.

new.s: The theme of HDR 2025 was:
o: Cultural Liberty in Today's Diverse World
A Matter of Choice: People and Possibilities in the Age of AI
new.x: HDR 2025 was titled 'A Matter of Choice: People and Possibilities in the Age of AI'; 'Breaking the Gridlock' was HDR 2023-24.

new.s: Before the 2010 revision, the HDI's income indicator was per capita:
new.x: Per capita GDP was used before 2010; GNI per capita came with the 2010 revision.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about HDI goalposts:
1. Expected years of schooling has a maximum of 18.
2. Mean years of schooling has a maximum of 18.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Expected schooling has a maximum of 18 years, but mean schooling has a maximum of 15.

new.s: In the HDI, the goalposts for GNI per capita (PPP $) are:
new.x: The income goalposts are $100 (minimum) and $75,000 (maximum).

new.s: The HDI uses PPP dollars mainly to:
o: Allow fair comparison across countries with different price levels
new.x: PPP dollars allow fair cross-country comparison across price levels; the logarithm reflects diminishing returns.

new.s: The HDI value for the 'very high' human development category is:
new.x: Very high is 0.800 and above; high is 0.700-0.799.

new.s: According to HDR 2025, inequality reduces India's HDI by about:
new.x: HDR 2025 notes that inequality cuts India's HDI by 30.7%.

new.s: India's National MPI headcount ratio fell from 24.85% in 2015-16 to ____ in 2019-21.
new.x: The headcount fell from 24.85% (NFHS-4) to 14.96% (NFHS-5).

new.s: How many indicators does India's National MPI use?
new.x: The National MPI uses 12 indicators: the Global MPI's 10 plus maternal health and bank account.

new.s: The Multidimensional Poverty Index is computed as:
o: Geometric mean of headcount and intensity
new.x: MPI = Headcount (H) × Intensity (A), where intensity is the average deprivation share among the poor.

new.s: Both the Global and National MPIs are computed using which method?
new.x: Both the Global and National MPIs use the Alkire-Foster method.

new.s: As per NITI Aayog's Progress Review 2023, which State had the highest multidimensional poverty?
new.x: Bihar was highest (51.89% to 33.76%, also the largest fall), followed by Jharkhand; Kerala was lowest.

new.s: Under PMGKAY, each beneficiary receives how much free foodgrain per month?
new.x: PMGKAY gives 5 kg per person per month; 35 kg is the entitlement of AAY families.

new.s: PMGKAY provides free foodgrains to about how many people?
new.x: PMGKAY covers about 81.35 crore people and was extended for five years from 1 January 2024.

new.s: The first Andhra Pradesh Human Development Report (2007) was prepared by:
new.x: CESS, Hyderabad prepared the AP HDR 2007, sponsored by the Planning Commission and UNDP.

new.s: The second National Human Development Report (India Human Development Report) was released in:
new.x: The second NHDR came in 2011, with Kerala first in HDI; the first NHDR was in 2001.

new.s: India's HDI as computed by UNDP is 0.685; the sub-national national average is:
new.x: 0.685 is the UNDP India value, while 0.732 is the sub-national national average.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's MPI value fell from 0.053 in 2015-16 to ____ in 2019-21.
new.x: AP's MPI fell from 0.053 to 0.025, about a 50% cut; 0.066 is India's value.

new.s: Among States, Andhra Pradesh ranks ____ by MPI (NITI MPI 2023).
new.x: Andhra Pradesh ranks 9th among States by MPI.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a form of human capital formation?
new.x: Human capital formation covers education, health, skills (on-the-job training), migration and information; machinery is physical capital.

new.s: The RBI Financial Inclusion Index rose from 53.9 in 2021 to ____ in 2025.
new.x: The RBI FI-Index stood at 67.0 in 2025, up from 53.9 in 2021.

new.s: The Gender Development Index was introduced in the HDR of:
new.x: GDI came in HDR 1995; HPI in 1997 and GII in 2010.

new.s: A Gender Development Index value near 1 indicates:
o: Female HDI half of male HDI
new.x: GDI is the ratio of female to male HDI, so a value near 1 means gender parity.

new.s: Chile has a higher HDI than Malaysia despite a lower GNI per capita mainly because Chile has:
o: About 7 more years of life expectancy and 3 more years of expected schooling
new.x: Chile's longer life expectancy and schooling give it a higher HDI; income is only a means.

new.s: The Human Poverty Index mainly indicates:
new.x: The HPI measured deprivation and indicates the standard of living.

new.s: HPI-2 was designed for:
new.x: HPI-1 was for developing countries and HPI-2 for developed countries.

new.s: Which of the following is an indicator of the Capability Poverty Measure?
new.x: The CPM uses children under 5 underweight, births unattended by trained personnel and female illiteracy; male labour-force participation is not one.

new.s: In HDR 2025, India's rank in the Gender Inequality Index was:
new.x: India was 102nd of 193 with a GII of 0.403, up from 108th.

new.s: In HDR 2025, India's GDI value of 0.874 placed it in:
new.x: India's GDI of 0.874 put it in Group 5, the farthest from parity.

new.s: Which index reads '0 = equality' with higher values meaning greater gender inequality?
new.x: Higher GII means greater inequality; for the GDI, a value of 1 means parity.

new.s: The loss in human development due to inequality is the gap between:
new.x: HDI minus IHDI gives the loss due to inequality.

new.s: Women's share of parliamentary seats is a Gender Inequality Index indicator of which dimension?
new.x: Parliamentary seats and secondary education fall under empowerment.

new.s: India's National MPI baseline report was released in:
new.x: The baseline report came in November 2021, based on NFHS-4.

new.s: India's National MPI is monitored under which initiative?
o: Global Indices for Reforms and Growth
new.x: The National MPI is monitored under GIRG (Global Indices for Reforms and Growth).

new.s: As per the Global MPI 2022, India's multidimensional poverty headcount was:
new.x: The Global MPI 2022 put India's headcount at 16.4% (about 234 million poor).

new.s: According to NITI Aayog's Progress Review 2023, about how many people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2015-16 and 2019-21?
new.x: About 13.5 crore escaped between 2015-16 and 2019-21; 24.82 crore is for 2013-14 to 2022-23.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National MPI Progress Review 2023:
1. Rural poverty declined faster than urban poverty.
2. Urban headcount fell to 5.27%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Rural poverty fell fastest (32.59% to 19.28%) and urban fell from 8.65% to 5.27%.

new.s: In NITI Aayog's MPI 2023, Andhra Pradesh's multidimensional poverty headcount was:
new.x: AP's headcount was 6.06% against India's 14.96%; 7.71% and 2.20% are AP's rural and urban figures.

new.s: Which State had the lowest MPI value (0.002) in NITI Aayog's 2023 report?
new.x: Kerala had the lowest MPI (0.002), followed by Goa (0.003) and Tamil Nadu (0.009).

new.s: In the Global MPI, each standard-of-living indicator carries a weight of:
new.x: Health and education indicators carry 1/6 each; the six standard-of-living indicators carry 1/18 each.
